title: Shrinking the Term Structure
scope: Reproduce the unmodified author executable core example on two bundled real Treasury cross sections (1986-06-30 and2013-12-31), full KR and KR-1 through KR-10. Add independent numerical and exact cross-sectional LOOCV verification.
limitations: Not a reproduction of all full-paper daily1961-2020 tables or investment performance.
Full Treasury prices/cash-flow history requires WRDS/CRSP access per repository README.
The two-date sample cannot verify recession or time-series risk premia claims.
